_doc: Spellbook v3 (bead bzc.99): the ornate school frame around each spell's parchment medallion, 48x48, shown at 2x around the 32 px spell icon shown at 2x. One generate-image-v2 call returns many candidates of a mixed subject; the clearest frame per school is accepted. The outputs fill the hole with the parchment medallion and, for the gilded (mastery) variants, add a gold fillet inside and a gold rim outside as recorded pixel edits computed by art/review/spell-frames.mjs from the accepted take, so the plain and gilded frames of a school share one take. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.concept: round ornamental school frames, one per school of magic
recipes.subject: Subject: each image shows exactly one of these 5 things, each thing about equally often: (1) a round frame ring made of bright green leaves woven around a green vine; (2) a round frame ring of shiny blue steel with four round silver rivets at the top, bottom, left and right; (3) a round frame ring of yellow brass shaped like a clock face rim with twelve dark tick marks; (4) a round frame ring of dark plum purple with four small silver crescent moons at the top, bottom, left and right; (5) a round frame ring of bright red with four jagged orange lightning-bolt spikes pointing outwards at the corners. The middle of every ring is an empty hole.

recipes.concept: square ornamental school frames with rounded corners, one per school of magic
recipes.subject: Subject: each image shows exactly one of these 5 things, each thing about equally often: (1) a square picture frame with rounded corners made of bright green leaves woven along a green vine, a big leaf at each corner; (2) a square picture frame with rounded corners of shiny blue steel with a round silver rivet at each corner; (3) a square picture frame with rounded corners of yellow brass with a small brass cog at each corner; (4) a square picture frame with rounded corners of dark plum purple with a small silver crescent moon at each corner; (5) a square picture frame with rounded corners of bright red with a jagged orange lightning bolt at each corner. The middle of every frame is a big empty square hole.

recipes.concept: frames-b with slim bars and a bigger hole, so a 32 px icon fits inside a 48 px frame
recipes.subject: Subject: each image shows exactly one of these 5 things, each thing about equally often: (1) a square picture frame with slim bars of twisted green vine and a big bright green leaf at each corner; (2) a square picture frame with slim bars of shiny blue steel and a round silver rivet at each corner; (3) a square picture frame with slim bars of yellow brass and a small brass cog at each corner; (4) a square picture frame with slim bars of dark plum purple and a small silver crescent moon at each corner; (5) a square picture frame with slim bars of bright red and a jagged orange lightning bolt at each corner. The bars are thin, only about one eighth of the frame's width; the empty square hole in the middle is big, about two thirds of the frame's width; the corner ornaments may be bigger than the bars.

recipes.concept: frames-c at 52 px with another seed
recipes.subject: Subject: each image shows exactly one of these 5 things, each thing about equally often: (1) a square picture frame with slim bars of twisted green vine and a big bright green leaf at each corner; (2) a square picture frame with slim bars of shiny blue steel and a round silver rivet at each corner; (3) a square picture frame with slim bars of yellow brass and a small brass cog at each corner; (4) a square picture frame with slim bars of dark plum purple and a small silver crescent moon at each corner; (5) a square picture frame with slim bars of bright red and a jagged orange lightning bolt at each corner. The bars are thin, only about one eighth of the frame's width; the empty square hole in the middle is big, about two thirds of the frame's width; the corner ornaments may be bigger than the bars.
